name: AI Product Description Generator (Bulk & Single) – AI Product Tools for WooCommerce

sections.description:
🚀 The Ultimate AI-Powered Bulk Product Description Generator for WooCommerce

AI Product Tools revolutionizes how you create product descriptions in WooCommerce. Powered by industry-leading AI technology from OpenAI (ChatGPT) and Google’s Gemini AI, this plugin helps you generate compelling, SEO-friendly product descriptions in seconds, not hours.

⚡ NEW: Powerful Bulk Generation
Generate professional product descriptions for your entire catalog in minutes! Free users start with 500 generation credits, while Pro users enjoy up to 5000 credits for massive catalogs.

  • 🤖 Dual AI Integration: Choose between OpenAI (ChatGPT) or Google’s Gemini AI
  • 🌍 Multi-Language Support: Generate content in any language

sections.installation:
1. Upload ‘ai-product-tools.zip’ to your ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory
  2. Activate AI Product Tools from the ‘Plugins’ menu
  3. Choose your preferred AI provider (OpenAI or Gemini AI)
  4. Enter and save your API key
  5. Customize your settings
  6. Start generating descriptions (single or bulk)
  7. Review and save your products
sections.faq:
Is AI Product Tools free to use?

Yes! The core features and 500 generation credits are completely free. You only need an API key from your chosen provider (OpenAI or Google Gemini AI).

How does the credit system work?

Each product description generation uses 1 credit. Free users start with 500 credits, Pro users get 5000 credits, and Business users enjoy unlimited credits. Credits are automatically renewed monthly.

How does the bulk generation work?

Our powerful bulk generator allows you to create descriptions for multiple products simultaneously:
– Free users: Generate up to 500 products per month
– Pro users: Generate up to 5000 products per month
– Business users: Unlimited generation
The bulk generator includes features like category filtering, batch processing, progress tracking, and generation history.

Can I pause and resume bulk generation?

Yes! Our smart bulk generation system allows you to pause, resume, and even cancel generation processes. Your progress is automatically saved, and you can continue from where you left off.

What happens if I run out of credits?

When you run out of credits, you can either wait for the monthly renewal or upgrade to a higher plan for more credits. Pro and Business users get priority in the generation queue.

Which AI provider should I choose?

Both OpenAI and Gemini AI deliver excellent results. OpenAI (ChatGPT) excels in creative writing, while Gemini AI often provides more structured, technical content. Try both to find what works best for your products!

Is the content SEO-friendly?

Absolutely! All generated descriptions are optimized for search engines while maintaining readability and engagement. The AI considers keywords, product attributes, and SEO best practices.

Can I customize the AI-generated descriptions?

Yes! You can customize:
– AI Provider selection
– Language preferences
– Writing style
– Description length
– Custom prompts
– Brand voice
– Product attributes integration
– Bulk generation templates

Is my data secure?

Yes! We prioritize security. Your API keys and product data are stored securely on your WordPress installation. We never store or access your API keys or product information on our servers.

What makes AI Product Tools different from other AI description generators?

AI Product Tools stands out with its powerful bulk generation system, dual AI provider support, and extensive customization options. Our focus on efficiency and scalability makes it perfect for both small shops and large e-commerce stores with thousands of products.
